list.empty_body: Trigger an analysis — an MR review, a diagram, a hobit run — and it will show up here.

config.title: Engine configuration
config.desc: Runtime settings for every engine worker. Stored in the database — changes need no restarts.

model.label: Default model
model.desc: Used by jobs without a more specific setting (hobits keep their own model). Applies to newly enqueued jobs.

timeout.label: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.desc: Per-job ceiling for a single engine run. Applies to newly enqueued jobs.

attempts.label: Retry attempts
attempts.desc: How many attempts a job may consume before a dead-worker sweep fails it. Picked up by all workers within ~5s.

concurrency.label: Worker concurrency
concurrency.desc: Jobs each engine instance runs in parallel (max 16 per instance). Picked up by all workers within ~5s.

retention.label: Job retention (days)
retention.desc: Settled jobs older than this are deleted hourly. 0 = keep forever.

repo.empty_title: No jobs for this repository yet
repo.empty_body: Engine runs triggered from this repository — analyses, diagrams, hobit runs, questions — will show up here.
